purpose: Concept paintovers only; not engine-render evidence
bakery:
Use case: lighting-weather / style-transfer.
Asset type: look-development direction board for the existing Harumachi anime town game. This is a concept paintover, not evidence of a rendered engine.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the actual game screenshot of the yellow-awning bakery.
Create ONE polished 2-by-2 lighting/material direction sheet. All four panels use precisely the same camera, perspective, crop, building silhouette, window and door locations, chimney, canopy geometry, cart, planters, paving, neighbouring buildings and tree positions from the target. Each panel must be 16:9, all four equal size, with a narrow clean gutter. No extra objects or people, no architecture redesign.
Style: beautiful Japanese TV anime background key frame, clean confident lines, restrained hand-painted surface detail, flat colour families and one or two clear shadow bands, luminous atmospheric depth, azure summer sky and sculpted cumulus. Makoto Shinkai-inspired transparent light and warm/cool separation, NOT photorealistic, NOT a painterly oil painting, NOT generic plastic 3D.
Four panels in reading order:
1 top-left: clear summer noon. Ivory plaster sunlit but not blown out, faint cool lavender shade under the yellow canvas awning, clear patterned shadows, varied roughness and soft narrow highlights on the wooden window frames, transparent glazing with bread visible.
2 top-right: overcast afternoon with light rain. Soft broad blue-gray skylight, luminous cloud cover, richer local colour retained, fine sparse rain streaks, warm bakery interior visible. Keep the paving matte, no puddles and no mirror-like road.
3 bottom-left: late afternoon golden sunlight at 17:20. Clear raking golden key light on roof edges and wood, calm lavender-blue shadows, coherent foliage cast shadows and warm subtle ground bounce; luminous but restrained sky, no heavy sepia cast. Preserve yellow canopy.
4 bottom-right: blue night 21:00. Warm bread display as the visual focal point, real light spilling close to the window and doorway, cool blue moonlit form and readable neighbouring street, starry anime sky; no excessive bloom, no white fog.
Materials: preserve every original texture identity and base palette, improve readability of fine directional wood grain, chalky plaster, matte woven yellow canvas, clay brick and translucent glass. Deliberate restrained gloss only on varnished joinery and glass, never blanket metallic or wet gloss. Fine contact darkening at actual joints, no dirt/noise overlays, no deep cracks, no fake emissive rims.
Constraints: preserve geometry and screen layout in every panel; only change lighting, atmosphere and fine material response. Do not add lamps, signs, silhouettes, depth of field blur, lens flare, text, captions, watermark or UI. High-quality art-direction paintover, target 2560x1440 or similar large landscape sheet.
lake:
Use case: lighting-weather / style-transfer.
Asset type: look-development paintover board for an existing Japanese anime town game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the real game view of an arched wooden footbridge at a lake.
Input image 2 is only a STYLE AND LIGHTING reference, the four-condition bakery concept sheet. Do not insert any bakery, street, building or object from image 2.
Create ONE beautiful 2-by-2 four-condition direction sheet, equal panels of 16:9 aspect with narrow gutters. Precisely preserve image 1 camera, perspective, bridge dimensions and plank/rail structure, its support positions, shore contour, tree locations, horizon, grass and water extents in all four panels. Do not redesign landscape or add objects/people.
Visual style: Japanese TV anime key frame, polished clean background linework, broad flat colour families, one or two confident shadow bands, softly simplified fine hand-painted details, luminous Makoto Shinkai-inspired sky/light. Not photoreal, no thick paint/brush noise, no plastic sheen.
Panels in reading order:
Top left clear summer noon: blue sky with elegant white cumulus, warm but subtle sunlight, clean cooler shadow family, lake reads as transparent turquoise/deep teal water with restrained directional ripples, atmospheric trees layer into pale blue in the distance.
Top right overcast light rain at 15:00: muted blue-gray luminous sky, soft environmental light, delicate ripples and sparse raindrops on the water, wood retains natural warm identity under cool light, readable foreground, quiet mist only at distant shore.
Bottom left clear golden evening at 17:20: warm sunlight grazes rail tops and planks, lavender-blue shadows, soft complementary sunset reflections broken into a few large readable bands, retain teal under the gold so the lake never looks brown or muddy. Subtle low haze far away.
Bottom right blue moonlit night at 21:00: deep ultramarine sky, readable cool wood and grass, restrained silver-blue reflection path on lake, very subtle cyan moonlit edges, no lamps added, no self glowing bridge.
Materials: board-aligned natural wood grain, subtle worn top edges, matte rough board sides, broad restrained highlights on handrails; quiet grounded support contacts. Water has depth and Fresnel directionality, with a few coherent reflection shapes rather than uniform fine noise. Foreground grass forms clean light/shadow groups, no masses of random highlights.
Constraints: same geometry and layout in all panels; change only shading, surface quality, vegetation colour hierarchy, sky, time and weather. No geometry enhancement, no extra flowers, no new rocks, no new mountains, no buildings, no signs, no text, no UI, no bloom haze across foreground, no camera blur. Large landscape art-direction board.
